purpose: Public source distribution checks; no production documents or desktop Word operated.

privacy_scan.scope: Explicit publishable text files, including source, tests, metadata, comments and docs; private identity/workspace markers, email, credential patterns and private IPv4 ranges checked.
privacy_scan.excluded: Caches, bytecode, original documents, logs, databases, original development history and private provenance paths are not part of the public file list.
privacy_scan.limits: Targeted automated checks plus inspection of discovered locations; this is not a guarantee against every possible privacy issue.

license.name: PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0
license.text: Official unmodified license text; project attribution is in NOTICE.

changes_for_public_distribution: Replace fixed personal interpreter path with sys.executable in test_codegen_extra.py.
Remove private workspace paths from instructions, provenance and historical validation metadata.
Keep only repository-relative provenance and engine file hashes.
Clarify early experimental status, incomplete support and permitted noncommercial improvements.
Normalize public text to LF with .gitattributes so checked-out engine hashes are portable.
historical_validation: references/validation.json; no claim that all historical suites were rerun for publication.
known_limits: No real desktop Word COM validation in this publication check.
Existing Windows system-path assumptions remain documented.
Arbitrary complex Word/LaTeX content and all automatic numbering formats are not covered.
